question:
Select the most appropriate synonym of the given word.

Energy
solution:
The correct answer is: **Power**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The word **"Energy"** refers to the strength and vitality required for sustained physical or mental activity. It is often associated with power or liveliness. (उर्जा)

 
 
• **Example:** She has so much energy that she can work tirelessly for hours without feeling fatigued.
 
 
 
• **"Power"** is a synonym for energy and signifies the ability to act or produce an effect; it may also refer to physical force or authority. (शक्ति)
 
 
• **Example:** The solar panels harness the power of the sun to generate electricity.
 
 
 
• Hence, the most appropriate synonym for **'Energy'** is **'Power'**.

Therefore, the correct answer is: **Power**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

Here are the other options explained along with their Hindi meanings and example sentences:

 
• **Frailty** (दुर्बलता): The condition of being weak or delicate.

 
 
• **Example:** His frailty became more evident as he aged.
 
 
 
• **Strife** (संघर्ष): Conflict or struggle between individuals or groups.
 
 
• **Example:** The political strife in the country has led to unrest among its citizens.
 
 
 
• **Speed** (गति): The rate at which someone or something moves or operates.
 
 
• **Example:** The car reached a speed of 120 kilometers per hour on the highway.
